input: Paint the front door a new color

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether this is just the door slab or includes the frame, trim, and hardware changes the amount of work, materials, and time required significantly.
The budget determines whether the user buys premium exterior paint, hires a professional, or works with basic supplies — directly shaping the plan.
The door material (wood, metal, fiberglass) affects which primer and paint type to use, and the prep steps needed before painting.
Whether the user is doing this themselves or hiring someone changes every step of the plan — from sourcing paint to scheduling the work.
If the user already has a color in mind versus needing help choosing, the plan either skips or includes a color-selection phase with swatches or samples.
Knowing when they want to start or finish matters because paint needs dry, mild weather, and the door may need to be left open for hours, which affects daily life.
Understanding whether the goal is a quick refresh or a flawless, long-lasting finish determines how many coats, how much surface prep, and what finish (matte, gloss, satin) to aim for.

gold.taskTitle: Paint the front door a new color
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to repaint their front door in a new color, which involves choosing a color, preparing the surface, and applying paint.

questions.title: Does this include the frame and trim, or just the door slab?
questions.description: Clarify the full scope of the painting project — door slab only, or also the surrounding frame, trim, and any sidelights.

questions.title: What is your budget for this project?
questions.description: Determine the available budget to guide decisions on paint quality, tools, and whether professional help is an option.

questions.title: What material is your front door made of?
questions.description: Identify whether the door is wood, metal, or fiberglass, as this determines the correct primer, paint type, and prep process.

questions.title: Are you planning to do this yourself or hire someone?
questions.description: Establish whether this is a DIY project or a professionally contracted job, which shapes every step of the plan.

questions.title: Do you already have a color picked out?
questions.description: Find out if a specific color has been chosen, or if the plan needs to include a color-selection phase with samples or swatches.

questions.title: When do you want to have this completed by?
questions.description: Understand the target timeline to account for weather windows, drying time, and whether the door can be left ajar during the day.

questions.title: Is this a quick refresh or a durable, flawless long-term finish?
questions.description: Clarify the quality standard expected — a fast touch-up versus a thorough, multi-coat, properly prepped result — to set the right level of effort.
